sourceBaselineEvidence.meaning: Replacement source baseline recorded by the November 4 rebuild; owned exclusions and adaptations remain.

ports.subject: fix(client-runtime): a thread keeps syncing after a stream defect (#31071)
fix(client): a big server config on a slow link no longer drops the connection in a loop (#23758)
fix: keep older pending questions answerable (#26435)
fix(server): preserve sibling wakeups when interrupting a completion wake (#28204)
fix(server): a stopped run no longer shrinks thread history to one row (#31266)
fix(server): refresh divergence after a merged branch ref changes (#31342)
fix(shared): command output keeps text after an unterminated OSC (#30479)
fix(shared): command output no longer prints the final byte of escape sequences with intermediates (#30724)
fix(shared): underline styles and colours no longer scramble command output colours (#21542)
fix(shared): recognize numeric bare-repository config (#27500)
fix(shared): ignore unfinished quoted Git config continuations (#30743)
fix(client-runtime): sanitized error stacks keep line and column for URLs with a query (#30726)
fix(client-runtime): pull request bodies with CRLF line endings keep their code blocks whole (#30352)
fix(search): keep whole-word title matches above busy prefixes (#32242)
fix(forgejo): tea's `pull` and `m` aliases count as shell merges (#32401)
fix(server): an invalid regex in project search still finds its text when Match case is off (#30569)
fix(provider-acp): preserve UTF-8 across interleaved terminal streams (#32391)
fix(shared): preserve IPv6 hosts when switching clone protocols (#30798)
fix(gitlab): `glab mr accept` counts as a shell merge (#32400)
fix(shared): cite assistant messages with IDs over 512 characters (#28084)
fix(shared): login-shell environment probe ignores DEBUG trap output (#32646)
fix(client-runtime): a search query pasted from github.com lists pull requests again (#30150)
fix(shared): IPv6 SCP remotes match SSH repository identities (#36547)
fix(shared): keep spreadsheet shorthand as inline code (#23203)
fix(shared): capture shell values after profiles replace PATH (#35617)
